checks.claim: ||g_i - g_j||_2 >= 2 sin(m) approx 0.9589 for ArcFace margin m = 0.5 rad

mathematical_derivation.step_1: Embeddings normalized on unit hypersphere S^{D-1}: ||g_i||_2 = ||g_j||_2 = 1.
mathematical_derivation.step_2: ArcFace angular margin penalty enforces decision cone separation theta_ij = arccos(g_i^T g_j) >= 2m between enrolled class centroids in zero-training-loss equilibrium.
mathematical_derivation.step_3: Euclidean chord distance: ||g_i - g_j||_2 = sqrt(2 - 2 cos theta_ij).
mathematical_derivation.step_4: Monotonicity of cos on [0, pi]: theta_ij >= 2m ==> cos(theta_ij) <= cos(2m).
mathematical_derivation.step_5: Trigonometric identity: 2 - 2 cos(2m) = 4 sin^2(m) ==> sqrt(4 sin^2(m)) = 2 sin(m).

assumptions: 1. Embeddings lie on unit hypersphere S^{D-1} (||g||_2 = 1).
2. Enrolled gallery prototypes satisfy the ArcFace angular margin separation condition theta_ij >= 2m.
3. Angular margin m in (0, pi/2) (here m = 0.5 rad approx 28.65 degrees).
checks.safe_manuscript_wording: Under additive angular margin loss (ArcFace) with margin parameter m, enrolled gallery centroids satisfying angular separation theta_ij >= 2m exhibit an Euclidean separation lower bound of ||g_i - g_j||_2 >= 2 sin(m) approx 0.9589 (for m = 0.5 rad).

checks.claim: Nearest-neighbor assignment phi(z) = g_{N(z)} exhibits step jump discontinuity across Voronoi cell boundaries

mathematical_derivation.step_1: Let V_i and V_j be adjacent Voronoi cells on S^{D-1} with facet boundary F_ij = overline{V}_i cap overline{V}_j.
mathematical_derivation.step_2: For x_0 in F_ij and unit normal vector n perp F_ij pointing from V_j into V_i: for eps > 0, x_0 + eps n in V_i (N = i) and x_0 - eps n in V_j (N = j).
mathematical_derivation.step_3: The composite mapping phi(z) = g_{N(z)} assigns phi(x_0 + eps n) = g_i and phi(x_0 - eps n) = g_j.
mathematical_derivation.step_4: Evaluating the limit: lim_{eps -> 0^+} ||phi(x_0 + eps n) - phi(x_0 - eps n)||_2 = ||g_i - g_j||_2 > 0.
mathematical_derivation.step_5: Because the limit does not equal 0 for distinct gallery prototypes (g_i != g_j), phi exhibits an essential step jump discontinuity.

rigorous_distinctions.A_Discontinuity: True jump discontinuity of magnitude ||g_i - g_j||_2 at boundary points x_0 in F_ij.
rigorous_distinctions.B_Non_Lipschitz_Behavior: phi is non-Lipschitz on any open neighborhood intersecting F_ij because ratio ||phi(u) - phi(v)|| / ||u - v|| -> infinity as u, v approach F_ij from opposite sides.
rigorous_distinctions.C_Unbounded_Global_Lipschitz_Constant: Global Lipschitz constant Lip(phi) is unbounded (infinity) over the unconstrained domain.
rigorous_distinctions.D_Local_Sensitivity: Small input perturbation delta across F_ij produces discrete macro output jump >= 2 sin(m).

assumptions: Distinct enrolled gallery items: g_i != g_j.
Nearest-neighbor rule N(z) = argmin_k ||z - g_k||_2 on S^{D-1}.
checks.safe_manuscript_wording: The composite nearest-neighbor prototype assignment phi(z) = g_{N(z)} exhibits an essential step jump discontinuity of magnitude ||g_i - g_j||_2 across Voronoi cell facet boundaries F_ij, resulting in unbounded local sensitivity across decision boundaries in unprotected pipelines.

checks.claim: Fail-closed quarantine restricts execution domain such that Lip(f_2) = 0 on unsafe inputs

mathematical_derivation.step_1: Under Layer-1 gating, if R_p(x) > tau_risk, the system executes fail-closed quarantine: f_gate(x) = bot.
mathematical_derivation.step_2: On the sub-domain of quarantined inputs X_quar = {x in X | R_p(x) > tau_risk}, the output is identically constant (bot).
mathematical_derivation.step_3: Any constant mapping f: X_quar -> {bot} has Lipschitz constant exactly Lip(f|_{X_quar}) = 0.
mathematical_derivation.step_4: On the certified sub-manifold X_cert = {x in X | R_p(x) <= tau_risk}, inputs are strictly contained within Voronoi cell interiors away from facet boundaries, bounding local sensitivity.
mathematical_derivation.step_5: Thus, composite error amplification is bounded to EAF = 0.0000 on quarantined corrupted regimes.

rigorous_distinctions.Constant_Quarantine_Map: Mapping to constant symbol bot has zero Lipschitz constant on X_quar.
rigorous_distinctions.Domain_Restricted_Map: The property applies to the domain-restricted gated pipeline, NOT claiming that the unconstrained baseline classifier is globally Lipschitz.
rigorous_distinctions.Global_Pipeline_Integrity: Gating intercepts inputs before Layer 2 execution, mathematically preventing evaluation on discontinuous Voronoi boundaries.

assumptions: Deterministic binary gating: R_p(x) > tau_risk halts downstream execution and maps to constant null state bot.
Domain is partitioned into certified region X_cert and quarantine region X_quar.
checks.safe_manuscript_wording: Under Layer-1 fail-closed gating, uncertified sensory inputs are mapped to a constant quarantine state (bot) with Lip(f_gate|_{X_quar}) = 0, preventing evaluation on discontinuous Voronoi boundaries and establishing EAF = 0.0000 on quarantined perturbations.
